svg.desc: Flame Graph - POST /logmeal/segment (food-diary backend) 3547 wall-clock samples at 1 ms per sample - 2026-05-17 Tool: pyinstrument 5.0.1 (statistical wall-clock profiler) Scale: 1180 px = 3547 samples (1 px = 3.006 ms) Frame height: 15 px | x margin: 10 px Reproduce: python -m cProfile -o profile.prof backend/profile_run.py flameprof profile.prof -format log > profile.folded flamegraph.pl profile.folded > docs/profiling/flamegraph.svg

g.title: profile_run.py:1:module (3,547 samples, 100.0%) - script entry point that boots FastAPI via TestClient and dispatches POST /logmeal/segment
starlette.testclient.TestClient.post (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - synchronous HTTP client entry; wraps async ASGI app in an httpx transport
[app startup: FastAPI init, dependency graph construction, TestClient setup, module imports] (157 samples, 4.4%)
httpx._client.Client._send_with_response (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - httpx sync client outer send loop; handles redirect following and auth flows
httpx._client.Client._send_single_request (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - dispatches one request through the configured transport
starlette.testclient._TestClientTransport.handle_request (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - bridges sync httpx client into async ASGI via asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete()
fastapi.applications.FastAPI.__call__ (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - top-level ASGI entrypoint; delegates to Starlette router after exception handler setup
starlette.middleware.base.BaseHTTPMiddleware.__call__ (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - middleware dispatch chain; includes ServerErrorMiddleware and any custom middleware
fastapi.routing.APIRouter.handle (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - matches URL /logmeal/segment to the registered APIRoute; resolves path parameters
fastapi.routing.run_endpoint_function (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - resolves Depends(get_current_user), injects UploadFile, calls the async endpoint coroutine
app.routers.logmeal.segment (3,390 samples, 95.6%) - reads UploadFile bytes, normalises MIME type, calls LogMeal API, uploads image to Supabase Storage, builds response
starlette.responses.JSONResponse.__init__ + json.dumps (3 samples, 0.1%) - serialises segmentation result dict to JSON response body
httpx._client.AsyncClient.post -> POST https://api.logmeal.com/v2/image/segmentation/complete (3,091 samples, 87.1%) - multipart upload to LogMeal; 30 s timeout configured
supabase._sync.storage.StorageFileAPI.upload -> PUT meal-images/{user_id}/{uuid}.jpg (291 samples, 8.2%) - uploads image bytes to Supabase Storage public bucket; failure is silently caught
httpx._client.AsyncClient.send (3,091 samples, 87.1%) - sends prepared request through httpcore connection pool; handles auth, cookies, redirects
httpx._client.AsyncClient.send (291 samples, 8.2%) - same httpx send path for Supabase Storage PUT request

httpcore._async.http11.AsyncHTTP11Connection.handle_async_request (3,091 samples, 87.1%) - manages HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection to api.logmeal.com; writes request headers and body, reads chunked response
httpcore._async.http11.AsyncHTTP11Connection.handle_async_request (291 samples, 8.2%) - HTTP/1.1 connection to Supabase Storage (*.supabase.co)

ssl.SSLSocket.read HOTSPOT (3,015 samples, 85.0%) - TLS receive buffer read; CPU blocked waiting for LogMeal API response bytes over the public internet. Network latency is the sole bottleneck - Python contributes <5% of total wall time.
g.text: ssl:SSLSocket.read ◀ HOTSPOT LogMeal HTTPS response (85.0%, ~3,015 ms)

g.title: httpcore TLS handshake + HTTP/1.1 header framing overhead (76 samples, 2.1%) - SSL negotiation and response header parsing on the LogMeal connection
ssl.SSLSocket.read (218 samples, 6.1%) - TLS receive for Supabase Storage PUT acknowledgement response (200 OK body)
Supabase TLS handshake + HTTP/1.1 framing overhead for storage connection (73 samples, 0.7%)
